subject: Prefer the crouched-posture transition when accelerating a lazy door-pass tail
description: Schema-12 representative `parity-random-save-replays-60s-15x/traces/Savegame_linux3/Profile_001/Savegame_000/replay-002-session-0001.jsonl.zst` formerly first diverged after frame 6496 only on PC126's logical animation: Original selected 84 / `TransitionWalkingCrouchedRunningUpright`, while Rust selected 51 / `TransitionWaitingUprightRunningUpright`. Frame 6493 records `make_pc_fast` while the PC's high-wall door pass is completing its explicit `TransitionCrouchingUp`; the remaining far-side walk was still stored in Rust's lazy `ActiveDoorPass` tail. Original constructs that high indirect PC chain as climb, crouched wait, `PassingDoor`, `TransitionCrouchingUp`, upright walk, and final `PassingDoor` (`original-code/RHelementactor.cpp:4645-4784`). `MakeFast` rewrites the movement and calls `PostProcessPath`; for a running movement, that routine chooses `TransitionWalkingCrouchedRunningUpright` from crouched posture before considering action state, and suppresses the waiting-upright transition on the crouched branch (`original-code/RHelementactor.cpp:6017-6042,7648-7703`; movement/order rewriting in `original-code/RHSequenceElementMovement.cpp:532-633`). Rust's lazy-tail helper instead chose solely from `ActionState::Waiting`, producing animation 51. Commit `0261e4ab0424f65f4ad3579eddc9277411a8cfb0` makes the helper prefer the source-defined crouched-posture transition while retaining the existing action-state choices for other postures. The focused `crouched_door_pass_make_fast_uses_crouched_running_transition_in_lazy_tail` regression models the materialized crouch-up prefix and untranslated upright-walk tail and passes 1/1. The authoritative optimized runner was `/home/phire/robinhood/target/parity/examples/original_parity_replay`, built from base HEAD `0d250c7ad440e7351ca42697faeca3171fcf2838` plus coordinated frozen diff `5b099cf9…` containing the exact patch, with SHA-256 `226d83c5deac0a89007d5fc1661cd5bb188d7d4c4908076a525486650679b6de`, size 65,888,107 bytes, and mtime `2026-08-11 17:18:37.685263604 +0200`. That runner matches every recorded frame through exact EOF for the representative and same-save control `parity-random-save-replays-60s-15x/traces/Savegame_linux3/Profile_001/Savegame_000/replay-001-session-0001.jsonl.zst`, both with exit status 0.
